name: FeO
notes: Imported 12.08.2026 from a beamline jcpds collection. Source file(s): JCPDS/dac_user_jcpds/FeO_B1.jcpds

eos_records.label: B1 Fe0.94O, Fischer et al. (2011)
eos_records.reference: Fischer et al., Earth Planet. Sci. Lett. 304, 496-502 (2011), doi:10.1016/j.epsl.2011.02.025
eos_records.notes: This file contains the B1, not B8, phase. Fischer et al. fit Fe0.94O with molar V0 = 12.256 cm^3/mol fixed, K0 = 149.4 +/- 1.0 GPa, and K0' = 3.60 +/- 0.04. V0 was converted to the conventional Z=4 B1 cell.
